s2:Low-mass Population III Star Formation due to the HD Cooling Induced by Weak Lym

rationale: The papers 2604.00197 and 2608.13656 investigate the effects of radiative feedback on protostellar growth and gas accretion in the context of supermassive stars, contributing evidence relevant to the question of whether protostars can acquire sufficient mass to overcome radiative feedback.
